title: Standing rules R1–R4 and the gate that enforces them

machinery.R2: computeFamilyClosure(blocked, open) — pure, negative-tested; live application in verify-family-closure-truth.ts
machinery.R4: foldOwedDetail() — a fold row is owed by every OTHERWISE-READY family; the trigger excludes foldPresent (so deleting a landed fold row still fails) and reads the live X1 closure result, refusing to adjudicate without one computed at HEAD
machinery.R6: lineBaseViolations(sources) — every metadata.line writer must be provably 1-based, directly or through a same-file helper whose every return is provably 1-based or an absence (static, fail-closed), negative-tested; live application in verify-standing-rules.ts itself
machinery.R7: sentinelRegisterDetail(census, register) — every placeholder-literal site in every analyzer is registered by source statement with an exact count; a new site, a grown site and a vanished site all fail (static, exact-count shrink-only), negative-tested. Census: script/m60/sentinel-census.ts (AST classification, self-tested). Runtime half disclosed as outstanding in the register
machinery.R8: frameworkRegisterDetail(census, register) — every framework-surface site is registered exactly, the class may only shrink, and the seven OO lanes' violations are additionally capped by the recorded OO target so a lane cannot be absorbed into the global baseline; a new site, a grown site, a vanished site, an absent artifact and a failed self-test all fail (static, exact-count shrink-only), 14 negatives. Census: script/m60/framework-surface-census.ts (17 self-tests). Runtime half: script/m60/framework-surface-probe.ts over fixtures and real corpora
